_comment: The materials tools/maze.mjs's scenes name by default - the walls with their doorways and tops (maze-default), the floor and the sky, as it once wrote into each scene itself - and two ambient lights for --material-ambient: maze-dusk, as its --sun 0.4 once made it, and maze-night, its darkest. They are named after --prefix's default, maze; a library for another prefix names its entries to match. It references this library unless given --library.
